name: Tiriri Transparency for EU AI Act
author: wpplugins2026

sections.description:
EU AI Act Article 50 becomes enforceable on August 2, 2026. Fines for non-compliance reach up to €15 million or 3% of worldwide annual turnover.

Tiriri scans your WordPress site for AI-powered tools — chatbots, content generators, AI-enhanced plugins — and helps you implement the required transparency disclosures with just a few clicks.

What Tiriri Does

1. Automatic AI Tool Detection
Tiriri scans your installed plugins and embedded scripts to detect AI-powered tools including:
* AI chatbots (Tidio, Intercom, Drift, Crisp, Tawk.to, and more)
* AI content generators (AI Engine, Jetpack AI, GetGenie, and more)
* AI-enhanced SEO tools (Yoast AI, Rank Math AI, AIOSEO)
* AI page builders (Elementor AI, Divi AI)
* AI translation tools (TranslatePress, Weglot)

2. Chatbot Disclosure Banner
Automatically displays a clear, accessible notice when visitors interact with an AI chatbot on your site — as required by Article 50(1).

3. AI Content Labeling
Add AI content status labels to any post or page:
* No AI used
* AI-assisted content
* AI-generated content
* AI-generated, human reviewed (exempt from labeling under Article 50(4))

4. Compliance Dashboard
A clear traffic-light dashboard showing:
* Which AI tools are detected
* Which require disclosures
* Your overall compliance status
* Days until enforcement deadline

5. Machine-Readable Metadata
Automatically adds structured data (Schema.org) and meta tags to labeled content, fulfilling the machine-readable marking requirements.

Who Needs This Plugin?

Any WordPress site that:
* Uses an AI-powered chatbot
* Publishes AI-generated content
* Uses AI-enhanced plugins (SEO, page builders, WooCommerce)
* Has visitors from the European Union

Free vs Pro

Free features:
* AI tool scanner (plugin detection)
* Basic chatbot disclosure banner
* Compliance dashboard with deadline countdown
* Manual AI tool declarations

Pro features:
* Third-party script detection (Intercom, Drift, etc.)
* AI content labeling system with editorial review workflow
* Machine-readable metadata injection
* Compliance report generator (PDF)
* Multi-language disclosures (all EU languages)
* WooCommerce integration
* Priority support

External services

This plugin relies on the following external services.

Freemius (licensing and update delivery)

Tiriri uses the Freemius SDK to manage licenses for Pro features and to deliver premium plugin updates. Freemius is only contacted when the plugin is activated on a site, when a license key is entered or activated, when the admin checks for plugin updates, or when the site administrator opts in to share diagnostic data.

The following data may be transmitted to Freemius when one of those events occurs: the site URL, site name, WordPress and PHP versions, the active license key (if any), the email address of the site administrator who opts in, and the plugin version. No visitor data and no post content is ever sent.

This service is provided by Freemius, Inc.:

  • Terms of Service: https://freemius.com/terms/
  • Privacy Policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the tiriri-transparency-for-eu-ai-act folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Tiriri > Dashboard to see your scan results
  4. Go to Tiriri > Settings to configure disclosure banners

The plugin automatically scans your site on activation and runs daily scans thereafter.
sections.faq:
What is the EU AI Act Article 50?

Article 50 of the EU AI Act requires transparency disclosures when people interact with AI systems. This includes informing users when they’re chatting with an AI chatbot and labeling AI-generated content.

When does this become enforceable?

Article 50 transparency obligations become enforceable on August 2, 2026. Penalties can reach €15 million or 3% of annual turnover.

Does my website need to comply?

If your website has visitors from the EU and uses any AI-powered tools (chatbots, AI content generation, etc.), you likely need to comply.

Will this plugin make me fully compliant?

Tiriri covers Article 50 transparency obligations for WordPress sites. Full EU AI Act compliance may require additional measures depending on your AI use cases. We recommend consulting a legal professional for comprehensive compliance.

Does this plugin slow down my site?

No. Tiriri adds minimal frontend code (< 3KB). The scanner runs in the background and does not affect page load speed.

What AI tools does it detect?

Tiriri detects 50+ popular WordPress AI plugins and 15+ third-party AI chatbot scripts. The database is regularly updated. You can also manually declare AI tools not automatically detected.
